entry.title: Drips 1.1.0
entry.summary: A granular texture synthesizer from Emilie Gillet's open-source Beads: four recording qualities, a delay and beat slicer, tempo-synced seeding, wavetables, a modulation page and a built-in manual. **1.1.0 is built with Akai's official MPC Plugin SDK** and runs on **MPC OS 3.10.1** with Enhancements → External Plugin Support. No modded firmware or root access needed any more. ## What's new - **Modulation on the main page:** a teal dot circles every knob the matrix moves; the snowflake lights up w

entry.title: Drips 1.0.0
entry.summary: **Drips 1.0.0** — a granular texture synthesizer for Akai MPC standalone devices, as an insert effect, built on Émilie Gillet's open-source Beads DSP. - Records the track into a 4–32 s buffer and replays it as up to 30 grains; four recording qualities (Bright Digital, Cold Digital, Sunny Tape, Scorched Cassette), each at its own sample rate. - Delay and beat slicer (SIZE fully clockwise), tempo-synced to the MPC. - Seed latched, gated, or clocked by MIDI notes or the MPC tempo; optional MIDI spl
